text:
maria (product): Drafting the PRD for consumption guardrails + billing semantics. putting a link to the doc: https://redwood.internal/prd/consumption-guardrails (WIP). Need focused feedback on: pricing semantics (soft vs hard limits), metering unit (tokens vs requests), API shapes for limits, and launch acceptance criteria.

alex (eng-runtime): taking a look. my first constraint: server-side enforcement needs to support per-tenant rate-sculpting + model-variant fallbacks. prefer token-based metering for accuracy. :+1:

jess (devex): FYI we'll need limits UI: tenant quota page + alerting setup. can we keep the UI changes to 2 new pages? otherwise scope expands. :eyes:

sam (sre): main risk is cascading failures when auth/timeouts spike. we should specify graceful degradation: `503 + Retry-After` for hard caps, `200 + warning` for soft caps with throttled payloads. add circuit-breaker metrics.

toby (sales): customers keep asking for "soft limit with overage opt-in" and per-tenant monthly commits. they want predictable billing but ability to burst. we should propose 3 modes: free-tier, committed, and burst-with-overage.

ina (legal): small flag — contract language for overages needs opt-in checkbox and clear invoice line items. add to PRD acceptance that billing notification and email 7 days before invoice.

kai (eng-platform): proposed API header shapes in the doc. quick example inline:```http
X-Quota-Limit: 50000
X-Quota-Remaining: 12345
X-Quota-Reset: 1710000000
X-Quota-Unit: tokens
```also suggest `quota_scope` query param for per-route vs tenant.

deploy-bot: deploy started for `prd/consumption-guardrails` branch — build #812.

alex (eng-runtime): implementation note: KV cache for prefix counting makes token metering cheap but edge cases: streaming responses where token counts are emitted incrementally. need a short design to handle streaming metering (emit tentative usage, finalize on stream close).

jess (devex): acceptance criteria idea (from UX):
- UI shows committed vs used vs burst in a single timeline
- ability to set soft limit thresholds with email/SMS alerts
- single-click enable overage for a tenant

maria (product): adding acceptance criteria block to PRD now. current draft picks token as canonical unit but allows request-count aliasing for batch endpoints. edge cases to call out: internal service-to-service traffic (should not be billed to tenant), retries vs replay safety, pre-signed webhooks.

sam (sre): test scenarios to add: sudden 10x traffic spike, region failover with duplicated requests, and partitioned quota-store (KV split). define SLA rollback behaviour if quota-store gets stale.

toby (sales): can we add a CSV export of tenant usage for finance reconciliation? customers ask.

ina (legal): also add audit log requirement for limit changes and billing plan changes.

kai (eng-platform): open question: will Dedicated customers expect the same metering? probably yes but with a toggle to suppress billing headers (private deployments). propose `billing_mode: hosted|dedicated|private` in account config.

maria (product): good point. proposed rollout plan: 1) internal beta (eng + SRE) with token metering and headers only; 2) public beta with UI + billing opt-in; 3) GA with overage and committed plans. launch acceptance (GA):
```
- server enforces hard caps correctly 99.99% of requests
- billing events emitted and consumed by finance pipeline
- UI shows usage within 5 min accuracy for committed plans
- migration docs for existing customers
```

alex (eng-runtime): I'll own server enforcement and streaming-metering design. planning spike on my calendar this week.

jess (devex): I'll prototype UI mocks, aim for EOW.

sam (sre): I'll add chaos tests and SLA rollback playbook.

maria (product): thanks all. action items added to PRD with owners. please comment inline on the doc by EOD Tuesday. cc @alex @jess @sam @kai @toby @ina. :rocket:
